# Competition-Colonization trade-off {#sec-ccto}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    \left\{
    \begin{aligned}
    \frac{d p_1}{dt} & = c_1 p_1 (1 - p_1) - e_1 p_1\\
    \frac{d p_2}{dt} & = c_2 p_2 (1 - (p_1 + p_2)) - e_1 p_2 - c_1 p_1 p_2
    \end{aligned}
    \right.
$${#eq-cc-tradeoff}


## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Competition-colonization tradeoff: three outcomes"
#| label: fig-cc-tradeoff-sim

library(deSolve)

# Function to define competition-colonization ODE system
cc_ode <- function(t, state, parms) {
  p1 <- state["p1"]
  p2 <- state["p2"]

  c1 <- parms["c1"]
  c2 <- parms["c2"]
  e1 <- parms["e1"]
  e2 <- parms["e2"]

  dp1_dt <- c1 * p1 * (1 - p1) - e1 * p1
  dp2_dt <- c2 * p2 * (1 - (p1 + p2)) - e2 * p2 - c1 * p1 * p2

  list(c(dp1_dt, dp2_dt))
}

# Time sequence
times <- seq(0, 100, by = 0.1)

# Scenario 1: Coexistence with dominant (species 1) abundant
# Species 1: good competitor, moderate colonizer
# Species 2: poor competitor, good colonizer
# At equilibrium: p1* = 0.5, p2* = 0.2
c1_s1 <- 0.5
c2_s1 <- 2.0
e1_s1 <- 0.25
e2_s1 <- 0.35
parms_s1 <- c(c1 = c1_s1, c2 = c2_s1, e1 = e1_s1, e2 = e2_s1)
state_init <- c(p1 = 0.1, p2 = 0.1)
traj_s1 <- ode(state_init, times, cc_ode, parms_s1)

# Scenario 2: Coexistence with dominant (species 1) less abundant
# Species 1: moderate competitor, low colonizer
# Species 2: poor competitor, higher colonizer
# At equilibrium: p1* = 0.2, p2* = 0.5
c1_s2 <- 0.25
c2_s2 <- 1.5
e1_s2 <- 0.2
e2_s2 <- 0.25
parms_s2 <- c(c1 = c1_s2, c2 = c2_s2, e1 = e1_s2, e2 = e2_s2)
traj_s2 <- ode(state_init, times, cc_ode, parms_s2)

# Scenario 3: Competitive exclusion
# Species 1: strong competitor, good colonizer
# Species 2: weak competitor, poor colonizer
c1_s3 <- 0.5
c2_s3 <- 2.0
e1_s3 <- 0.25
e2_s3 <- 1.0
parms_s3 <- c(c1 = c1_s3, c2 = c2_s3, e1 = e1_s3, e2 = e2_s3)
state_init3 <- c(p1 = 0.1, p2 = 0.2)
traj_s3 <- ode(state_init3, times, cc_ode, parms_s3)

# Create plot with three panels (one for each scenario)
par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

# Panel 1: Coexistence with S1 abundant
plot(times, traj_s1[, "p1"], type = "l", col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.7),
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Proportion occupied (p)",
     main = "Coexist: S1 abundant",
     ylim = c(0, 1), lwd = 2)
lines(times, traj_s1[, "p2"], col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.7), lwd = 2)
legend("right", legend = c("Species 1", "Species 2"),
       col = c(rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.8), rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.8)),
       lwd = 2, cex = 0.75)

# Panel 2: Coexistence with S1 less abundant
plot(times, traj_s2[, "p1"], type = "l", col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.7),
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Proportion occupied (p)",
     main = "Coexist: S1 less abundant",
     ylim = c(0, 1), lwd = 2)
lines(times, traj_s2[, "p2"], col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.7), lwd = 2)

# Panel 3: Competitive exclusion
plot(times, traj_s3[, "p1"], type = "l", col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.7),
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Proportion occupied (p)",
     main = "Exclusion: S2 extinct",
     ylim = c(0, 1), lwd = 2)
lines(times, traj_s3[, "p2"], col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.7), lwd = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
